correctness.rationale: The four team indices represent all one-letter valuations and their powerset, not a sample. Each semantic clause is derived exactly from arXiv:2610.15680v1 Sec.3.1. Structural induction proves this finite closure covers formulas of arbitrary depth. The explicit pair (10,12) has depth 2 and is absent at depth <=1; the negation supplies (12,10). No unknown premises or external certificates are used.

value.rationale: Determines the complete two-polarity denotational algebra of the smallest nontrivial BSL fragment and its sharp modality nesting threshold, a natural invariant for the new 2026 bilateral-to-semiltattice modal translation. The 11 support-only projections are all available at depth 0, so a support-expressivity classification cannot detect the sharp paired depth-2 obstruction. This is an exact complete finite classification with a specific proof-reuse baseline, not an arbitrary unmotivated sample; it makes no claim of broad asymptotic or complexity results.
